actual_scope: Prove that b unrestricted S3 convolutions need at least 10b bilinear scalar products over any coefficient ring admitting specialization to a characteristic-three field. Deduce unavoidable factors of three in denominators of rational formulas below that length, including the nine-product mechanism of PR2224.
scope_change_reason: Changes the current coframe/card experiment to the exact-coefficient admission boundary of the published nonabelian convolution mechanism. This is a new scoped denominator obstruction, not a selected-word search, audit or supplier claim.
bottleneck_link: PR2224 proposes a nine-product nonabelian rank-shape mechanism but leaves division by six unpaid. The obstruction rules out keeping nine products with purely dyadic or binary-Fourier exact coefficients, including joint block formulas. Exact division or more products must be priced before any physical gain.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved denominator obstruction after exact modular corroboration; do not seek an optimal dyadic construction or price a hypothetical selected supplier.
evidence: Written specialization proof using the classical Alder--Strassen bound and a characteristic-three nilpotent ideal with quotient K x K. The self-contained verifier checks dimensions (4,2,0), 36 basis products, 64 radical triple products, all 729 F3[S3] elements (324 units), coefficient residue maps and eight rejection controls. No predecessor scientific replay.
